message.name: EXT_EXAMPLE_PING
message.description: Request; the vehicle answers with EXT_EXAMPLE_PONG carrying the same seq and payload.

message.name: EXT_EXAMPLE_PONG
message.description: Reply to EXT_EXAMPLE_PING, sent once on every running link.
message.field: Sum of the request payload bytes

message.name: EXT_EXAMPLE_STATUS
message.description: Counters, 2 Hz by default; rate set per link with SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL.
message.field: EXT_EXAMPLE_PONG messages sent, summed over links
Incremented per EXT_EXAMPLE_STATUS sent on any link
